title: Premature Microservices
pattern: Separating cohesive domain entities into physically distinct network-bound services during early development phases.
why_bad: Swaps fast, compile-time checked in-memory calls for slow, brittle network boundaries, forcing complex tracing, retries, and network failure management.
detection: Separate network-bound services that are highly coupled, where changes in one require synchronized changes and deployments in the other.
counterexample: Highly scalable, independent subsystems with stable boundaries.
fix: Consolidate the services into a single monolithic binary, using clean module boundaries.
source: Titus Winters et al., *Software Engineering at Google* (2020); Juval Löwy, *Righting Software* (2019).
